reel_input.concept_seed: A small working flywheel engine runs on a stone workbench. Beside it stand copies cast in solid bronze with no core: flawless, sharply detailed, every part fused, none of them able to turn. The original is worn, fingerprinted and oiled; the copies are immaculate because they have never worked. Beside the original lies an unfinished flywheel for the next engine.
reel_input.doctrine_theme: Authorship is maintenance, then the next build

theme: Authorship is maintenance, then the next build
core_metaphor: A mold cast without a core records only the outside, so each copy is solid metal in a perfect silhouette. The original runs because its parts are separate, fitted, oiled and kept. The copy has the appearance of excellence; the original has the evidence of use.
emotional_arc: provocation -> respect for the copy -> distinction -> maintenance -> already building the next one
quote: A mold takes the shape. Not the work that keeps it turning.

cinematic_layers.layer_1_philosophy: Voice. Documentary narrator. The doctrine is the intellectual foreground. Always forward.
cinematic_layers.layer_2_atmosphere: Music. Sub-bass industrial drone. Answers: what emotional temperature does this doctrine exist in? Answer: cold machinery. Not pressure. Not urgency. The machine that doesn't care.
cinematic_layers.layer_3_space: Silence. Between 'That is the trap.' and the pivot line, that silence is doing work. It is not empty.

dynamic_profile.music_directive: recover to reference level. Mechanical pulse returns.

dynamic_profile.relationship: Voice exits. Music cuts at seam. Silence holds for the loop.

silence_function.post_hook: Cage is built. Viewer hasn't yet realized they're inside it.
silence_function.post_trap: Trap named. Nothing more is said. The diagnosis is complete.
silence_function.post_directive: 'Move.' is a full stop. Not a transition.
silence_function.loop_seam: Grammatical and musical void. The loop resolves into 'You are not preparing.' which is not a resolution. It is a restart.

visual_prompt.primary_prompt: Restrained photorealistic 9:16 sequence in one near-black stone workshop. On a worn charcoal stone bench a small single-cylinder engine (upright cylinder at the left, flywheel at the right) of aged brass (#C6A94F) and black iron runs at one steady speed; its five-spoke flywheel turns clockwise, crank and piston rod linked. The brass is worn and fingerprinted with a thin oil sheen. Beside it stand flawless copies cast in solid dark bronze, every part fused, perfectly still. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left and never moves. Locked or slow camera, real machined metal. No steam, no glow, no sparks, no lettering.

ALL transitions must be cut-hard or precision wipe. No dissolves.
Maintain 9:16 vertical framing at all times. No reframe.

script.full_text: Someone copied your work. Perfect copy. Dead engine. They copied everything they could see. Every contour. Every detail. A mold takes the shape. Not the work that keeps it turning. Run your mind. Run your systems. Build the next one. And let them copy
script.mobius_note: Final segment stays open: 'let them copy' resolves at loop restart with 'Someone copied your work.'.

segments.text: Someone copied your work. Perfect copy. Dead engine.
segments.visual_prompt: Already turning on the first frame: extreme close-up of the worn original's black iron five-spoke flywheel spinning clockwise at one steady speed, filling the frame, its aged brass (#C6A94F) crank flashing. One short, controlled lateral move to the right reveals by the second second the identical solid bronze copy beside it, its flywheel motionless, a bone-white (#F5F2EB) edge of light along its rim. By the third second the move settles and holds both engines side by side in one low frame: the original turning, the copy dead still.

segments.text: They copied everything they could see. Every contour. Every detail.
segments.visual_prompt: Slow lateral track along a row of solid bronze copies: crisp bolt heads, clean even patina, flawless and still, every joint fused. At the far end, soft in the background, the worn original's flywheel keeps turning.

segments.text: A mold takes the shape. Not the work that keeps it turning.
segments.visual_prompt: Macro on the hub of the worn original's black iron flywheel, an oiled brass collar gleaming as it turns at one steady speed; behind it, soft and out of focus, the bronze copy's flywheel, fused and still. No rod or crank in frame.

segments.text: Run your mind. Run your systems. Build the next one.
segments.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of a Ghanaian man in his mid-sixties with deep brown skin, close-cropped grey hair and a short grey beard, in a charcoal work shirt and worn leather apron, holding an unfinished raw grey cast-iron flywheel casting at chest height beside the running original engine. The camera pushes in slowly; he looks from the lens to the engine and smiles slightly. The engine's flywheel never changes speed.

The two engines side by side in the same low frame and light, the original turning, the copy still. The camera eases left and in until the worn original's spinning five-spoke flywheel fills the frame again, matching the opening close-up for a seamless loop. Its rim catches a thin line of gold.

final_segment_override.note: Final word trails into silence. Grammatically unresolved, inviting loop restart. Ellipsis drives the TTS decay.

sound_brief.emotional_temperature: cold, mechanical, inevitable. Not triumphant, not inspirational.

sound_brief.energy_arc: Constant low mechanical tension through hook and build. Sub-bass distortion surge at 20s pivot mark. Immediate return to reference level under directive. BPM-locked hard cut at loop seam 'you are...' with no decay or fade.
